items.title: 67296_Chauncey Morehouse oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...including Benny Goodman, Toots Mondello... Do you remember that? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: Yes. You made some records, Harry Rosenthal and his orchestra including Benny Goodman, Toots Mondello, Arthur Rollini, George Van Epps, Harry Goodman, Sammy Weiss, 1934. Do you remember that?
